answer: To prevent cheap mass registration, each identity must also cultivate a lotus badge earned through verified work over several epochs, and reputation flows along a vine of peer attestations rather than self-claims. Sybil resistance here ties each agent to a staked reputation slot bound at the wharf of entry, where new participants must burn a small deposit to register. Attackers must pay the deposit plus sustained labor per fake identity, making large sybil farms economically irrational. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
